title: A byte-bounded expert cache with leases and settled-only eviction
description: expert-residency's ExpertCache keyed by ExpertKey (revision, layer, expert, encoding): a plan acquires a lease on each expert, admitting a miss by evicting the least recently acquired expert that is unpinned and settled; an expert that finds every candidate pinned is not resident. The plan's leases close when it returns; an engine keeps them until its kernel completes. slots * expert_bytes is the capacity, expert_bytes an expert's encoded extent.
